# Bundled PDF.js

PDF renderer: Mozilla PDF.js / `pdfjs-dist` **6.3.289**, downloaded from the npm registry.
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js and https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/.
The legacy ES module build, worker, CMaps, standard fonts and WebAssembly assets are bundled locally so reading does not depend on a CDN.
License: Apache-2.0; the original license is retained at `pdfjs/LICENSE`. Embedded asset notices remain unchanged.

EasyRead was studied for architectural ideas; its implementation is not copied into this UI.
